targets.title: Amygdala hyperreactivity in restrictive anorexia nervosa
targets.evidence_quote: Our aim was to replicate the original study ( 30 ) with the same research question in a larger but similar sample, using the identical study design and closely following the fMRI and analysis protocol.
targets.outcome_quote: In the replication study, we were not able to identify elevated BOLD responses of the right amygdala and decreased activation in midcingulate cortices (MCC) in AN compared to NP in the between-group analysis and therefore could not replicate the original study ( 30 ).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion explicitly states that the original study could not be replicated, based on the central between-group amygdala and midcingulate effects. Similar within-group activation does not override that overall verdict. Sample-size limitations are acknowledged without declaring this attempt unable to adjudicate the finding.

reasoning: Matched title and authors. New AN and non-patient participants re-test reference 30. Uher supplies some materials and background comparisons; it is not an additional replication target. Alternative analyses concern the new data and are not reproductions.
